SPEAK TO THE SCHOOL

Plan your visit

Visiting hours: Monday-Friday, 12:00-14:30. Call ahead to arrange your visit.

Call 015 065 0271All contact details
01

Admissions

Confirm with the school

Applications are handled directly by the school. Current application dates, available places and admissions policies have not been supplied for this website.

Before you apply, ask:

  • Is there a place available in the grade you need?
  • When and where should you apply?
  • Which forms and documents are needed?
  • Who can help with learning support or access needs?
Contact the school about admissions
02

Documents

General preparation guidance

The checklist below helps you prepare for an enquiry. It is not the school’s confirmed document list.

  • Learner’s birth information.
  • Immunisation or Road to Health record, if available.
  • Previous report or transfer information, where applicable.

Ask the school to confirm the documents it needs and what to do if an item is unavailable. Do not upload learner documents to this website or send them to the developer.

Use the preparation checklist

COMMON QUESTIONS

Good questions to ask.

Can I apply on this website?

No. Contact the school to confirm its current application process. Do not send learner identity documents through this website or to the website developer.

What documents are commonly requested?

The DBE’s general guidance lists a birth certificate, immunisation record and, where relevant, a transfer card or previous report. Confirm the current process and accepted alternatives directly with the school or provincial department.

Read general DBE admissions guidance
Where can I find admissions dates and school hours?

School and visiting hours are listed on our contact page. Admissions dates have not been supplied. Contact the school for current arrangements.

How can I support learning at home?

Try a short reading session, a counting activity or a conversation about something your child noticed. Our learning hub includes simple activities with no account required.

Open the learning hub

EVERYDAY SCHOOL LIFE

Small routines make a difference.

Before school

Check homework, pack learning materials and prepare clothing the evening before. Confirm arrival and collection arrangements with the school.

Stay in touch

Keep contact details up to date with the school. Discuss absences, learning concerns and changes to collection arrangements directly with staff.

Learning support

If a learner is struggling, start a conversation with their teacher. Share what you notice and ask which small activities will help at home.
